label: text
text: M. Poineare has formed his Cabinet. The portfolios of MM Poineare. Barthou, Friend and Surraut are as forecasted.

label: text
text: The portfolios of Labour and Agriculture have not yet been plotted.

label: text
text: M₀ Poincare's Cabinet includes six ex-Premiers—M.M. Briand, Barthou, Herriol, Painleve, Leygues, and Poincare. Others have been Ministers at least once with the exception of M. Fallheres, son of an ex-President of the Republic.

label: text
text: The Ministry represents every party except the Socialists who address to the capital levy and are unable to collaborate owing to the decisions of their congress.

label: text
text: The composition of the Cabinet ensures it a substantial majority in the Chamber and practically an unanimous vote in the Senate.—Minister of Labour.

label: text
text: M. Queuilles is Minister, of Agriculture and M. Fallieres, Minister of Labour.

label: text
text: M. Poincare, in a statement to the Press, says that he did not encounter any difficulties in forming a very broad-cased Ministry of the National Union representative of all parties without attempting to allocate portfolios on the percentage basis. If he had paid attention to all the suggestions he would have spent endless time seeking an ideal solution and at present no time must be lost.

label: text
text: M. Poincare was cheered by the crowds on leaving the Elysee. Reuter.

label: text
text: A crowd last evening collected at a point on the Boulevard where motor coaches assemble for the daily tour of the capital, and hooted foreign passengers.

label: text
text: The demonstrators were so threatening that the passengers were compelled to descend.

label: text
text: Finally two coaches succeeded in pushing their way through the people barring the road.

label: text
text: The police were summoned and extricated British and American tourists from the crowd.

label: text
text: Senator Reed has declared his intention to recommend tourists to boycott France if the anti-American incidents continue, adding that the boycott of France is folly and that she is behaving outrageously toward a nation which feels for her nothing but friendship and goodwill.—Reuter.

label: text
text: At the close of business the French franc improved to 205½ and the Belgian to 201½.—Reuter.

label: text
text: Before the British and German Mixed Arbitral Tribunal which deals with the settlement of war-time commercial debts, the Hongkong and Shanghai Bank established a claim against Giosel & Co. for Shanghai Triels 7,107.62 with interest, in respect of bills of exchange.

label: text
text:
The Tribunal held that the proper date for ascertaining the rate of exchange for converting the amount payable in Shanghai taels was the date on which the debt became payable. Furthermore, the ereditors were entitled to recover the amounts of bills converted into Shanghai taels on the dates when the bills were dishonoured by non-acceptance.
No award was made respecting costs.—Router.

label: text
text: The newspapers are considerably preoccupied with the troubles of Roman Catholics in Mexico, where the new law regulating religion becomes effective in August 1.

label: text
text: A Mexico City despatch states that President Calles has issued a proclamation prohibiting religious instruction and worship in all schools and forbidding any cleric to direct a private school.

label: text
text: Telegrams from Nogules and Arizona report that the Archbishop of Mexico and the Bishop of Tobasco have been arrested on a charge of violating the law by calling "on" Catholics to exert economic pressure on the Government with the object of obtaining an amendment of the church laws.—Reuter.

label: text
text: [A previous cable stated:—The American Consular clerk, Vogelweid, who is charged with photographing the Sasebo fortifications, underwent a secret preliminary trial in Nagasaki on Wednesday. The case was adjourned till Monday, accused being remanded in custody of the Consul.]

label: text
text: "Hamburg" arrived at Yokohama this morning, being the first German warship to visit Japan since the outbreak of "the World War. German Embassy" officials, high Japanese naval officers and other Government officials greeted the arrival of the vessel.

label: text
text: A series of entertainments has been planned.—Reuter.

text: Mr. Alan Cobham arrived at Calcutta this afternoon, alighting on the river off Belur Ghts. Both sides of the river were crowded with spectators. He took five hours to fly from Patna. British Wireless Service.

label: text
text: The City is sweltering under the heat wave, the temperatura being 97 in the shade. There were seven deaths yesterday.—Reuter's American Service.

Cleveland (Ohio), July 23.
A merger is announced between the Central Steel Company, of Massillon, and the United Alloy Steel Corporation, of Canton (Ohio), under the title of the Central Alloy Steel Corporation. The assets exceed $80,000,000.

label: text
text: The Southern Railroad Directors have approved of a merger with the Missouri-Kansas-Texas-St. Louis-South-western systems.—Reuter.

label: text
text: Considerable economies have been effected in the cost of the Colonial services for 1926, which are explained in a White Paper issued to-day.

label: text
text: The total expenditure provided for is £442,070, compared with £1,107,000 last year.

label: text
text: In East and West Africa the situation is very satisfactory.

label: text
text:
Tanganyika is now paying her way, with a consequent saving of £350,000, and in Uganda the progress of the cotton-growing industry has brought a substantial surplus.
Kenya has also wiped out her
